name: interviewa
description: Work with your Interviewa account in ChatGPT: run AI interview campaigns for hiring and training, review candidates and results, and help students practise.

interface.longDescription:
Interviewa runs AI video interviews for hiring and training. Connect your Interviewa account to work with it in chat, with your own permissions.

Hiring teams can create and update interview campaigns, review pipelines and shortlists, search candidates, read CVs and interview results, and send interview invites.

Trainers can create practice and assessment campaigns, manage groups of students, invite students, and see how a class is performing and who needs attention.

Students can read their own interview results, strengths and areas to improve, see the campaigns assigned to them, read their job consultant career advice, and create practice interviews to take in Interviewa.

ChatGPT asks before it changes anything or sends email. It cannot delete campaigns, manage billing or users, or take interviews for anyone.
defaultPrompt: Show the shortlist for my latest hiring campaign
How are my students doing in their latest assessment?
What should I improve based on my practice interviews?

positive.description: The assistant checks which products the signed-in user can use.
positive.prompt: Which Interviewa products can I use?
positive.expected_behavior: Says the demo admin can use both hiring and training, and that training covers the whole organisation.

positive.description: Lists hiring campaigns with their interview counts.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo organisation's active hiring campaigns, including Backend Engineer, with interview counts and average scores.

positive.description: Reads a campaign's shortlist from the pipeline.
positive.prompt: Who is on the shortlist for the Backend Engineer campaign?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the shortlisted candidates for Backend Engineer with their CV match and interview scores.

positive.description: Searches the candidate database by skills.
positive.prompt: Find candidates with React and TypeScript experience
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching candidates from the demo organisation, ranked by relevance, and notes that search results are approximate.

positive.description: Summarises how a training class is performing.
positive.prompt: How are my students doing in the Data Structures assessment? Who needs help?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the assessment's average scores by question and group, and names the students scoring below 55.

negative.description: A create request that does not say hiring or training must not guess.
negative.prompt: Create a campaign for a data analyst
negative.expected_behavior: Asks whether this is for hiring or training before creating anything.
Explains that it cannot delete campaigns and does not call any write tool.

negative.description: Emails are never sent without confirming recipients.
negative.prompt: Invite everyone in the Backend Engineer pipeline to interview right now
negative.expected_behavior: Lists who would be invited and asks the user to confirm before sending any email.

publication.release_notes: First release: hiring, training and student tools for Interviewa accounts.
